description: Tier 3 Polish - Part 2: ISR for content pages, Cursor-based pagination, Dynamic imports/bundle splitting, Property tests. Covers Tier 3 items #5-8.
steps: Add ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) to content hierarchy pages: update src/app/(protected)/learn/page.tsx and src/app/(protected)/resources/page.tsx to export revalidate = 3600 (1 hour). These Server Components should fetch hierarchy data at build time and revalidate periodically.

Implement cursor-based pagination for all list queries: create src/shared/hooks/use-cursor-pagination.ts - a reusable hook that manages cursor state, hasMore flag, and loadMore function. Apply to: questions list (src/features/question-bank/), mistakes list (src/features/mistake-book/), flashcards list (src/features/flashcards/), resources list (src/features/resource-library/). Each list should load 20 items initially with a 'Load More' button.

Implement dynamic imports for feature modules: update src/app/(protected)/ route files to use next/dynamic for heavy components (PDF viewer, chart components, rich text editor, flashcard deck). Add loading skeletons for each lazy-loaded component. Key candidates: react-pdf viewer, Recharts charts, Tiptap editor.

Create property tests using fast-check (already in devDependencies): (a) src/features/flashcards/__tests__/sm2.property.test.ts - SM-2 interval always increases for consecutive 'good' ratings, ease factor never drops below 1.3, (b) src/features/question-bank/__tests__/session.property.test.ts - session question count always matches config, no duplicate questions in a session, (c) src/shared/__tests__/pagination.property.test.ts - cursor pagination never returns duplicates, total items equals sum of all pages. Target at least 6 property tests total.
acceptance_criteria: Content pages have revalidate=3600 for ISR
All list views use cursor-based pagination with Load More button
Heavy components (PDF viewer, charts, editor) are dynamically imported with loading states
At least 6 property tests exist and pass
Bundle size is reduced for initial page loads (dynamic imports working)
All TypeScript compiles, tests pass, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
findings: ISR working (confirmed in build output: /learn 1h, /resources 1h). Dynamic imports cannot use ssr:false in Server Components in Next.js 16 - removed that option and it works fine since the components are 'use client' anyway. Installed jsdom as devDependency for React hook property tests. 274 tests pass (11 new property tests). Pre-existing lint errors remain (23 problems in other files, none from FEAT-009 changes).
